q: Entropy conjugacy (Bowen, 1978): two subshifts of finite type with the same topological entropy are related by the existence of a common extension. Specifically, every mixing SFT of entropy log λ is:
opts: A factor of the full shift on ⌈λ⌉ symbols
An extension of every other mixing SFT of the same entropy
Conjugate to the Bernoulli shift of the same entropy
exp: Bowen's entropy conjecture (proved by Adler-Marcus): any mixing SFT of entropy h is an extension of every other mixing SFT of entropy h. Two mixing SFTs are topologically conjugate iff they have the same entropy AND the same period—but they are entropy-conjugate (common extension) based on entropy alone.
